One simple way to use all three directories.

A new walkthrough of search, product details, comparison, export and daily updates.

Download tutorial MP4 ↓

  1. Search. Type a product, brand, model, character or feature. Use Brand, Retailer and Category to narrow the results. Reset clears your filters.
  2. Inspect. Open a product photo or title. Review the exact offer, specifications, photo scope, source links and dates. Unknown means not verified.
  3. Compare. Tick Compare on product cards. Open Compare for a side-by-side view. Your selections stay as you search other pages.
  4. Export. Export the matching search results, or only your selected items. The CSV includes prices, dates, source links and photo URLs.
  5. Stay current. Open News & updates. Source news and new-to-directory items have separate labels and dates. Use the top links to switch directories.

The walkthrough shows the redesigned interface using saved catalog records. Prices and product availability can change after the recorded observation.
